changeSet.sql: UPDATE vehicle_cards SET image_path = CASE slug WHEN 'volkswagen-polo-sedan-wrapped' THEN '/images/cars/стандарт/volkswagen-polo-sedan.png' WHEN 'ford-mustang-wrapped' THEN '/images/cars/премиум/ford-mustang.png' WHEN 'toyota-rav4-city' THEN '/images/cars/кроссовер/Toyota RAV4.png' WHEN 'bmw-530i-business' THEN '/images/cars/премиум/BMW 530i.png' WHEN 'kia-carnival-family' THEN '/images/cars/минивэн 7 мест/Kia Carnival.png' WHEN 'porsche-911-icon' THEN '/images/cars/эксклюзив/Porsche 911.png' WHEN 'tesla-model-3-electric' THEN '/images/cars/электро/Tesla Model 3.png' WHEN 'mini-cooper-cabrio-sun' THEN '/images/cars/кабриолет/Mini Cooper Cabrio.png' WHEN 'toyota-land-cruiser-trail' THEN '/images/cars/внедорожник/Toyota Land Cruiser.png' WHEN 'ford-transit-cargo' THEN '/images/cars/грузовой/Ford Transit.png' ELSE image_path END WHERE slug IN ( 'volkswagen-polo-sedan-wrapped', 'ford-mustang-wrapped', 'toyota-rav4-city', 'bmw-530i-business', 'kia-carnival-family', 'porsche-911-icon', 'tesla-model-3-electric', 'mini-cooper-cabrio-sun', 'toyota-land-cruiser-trail', 'ford-transit-cargo' ) AND (image_path IS NULL OR image_path NOT LIKE '/uploads/vehicle-cards/%');
